purpose: Create and verify a bounded immutable selected-component release package using the existing recovery bundle inventory/security code

api.request: Reuse recovery_bundle::BundleRequest/ReleaseIdentity/RootSpec; no parallel release identity or file inventory framework

pins.schema_rule: Each request and manifest pins exactly one supported schema: schema_min equals schema_max. Existing immutable schema12 and schema13 packages remain valid; schema13 adds only canonical report correlation; schema14 is the current Host schema (briefing notifications, migration-014) and adds no packaging semantics.
pins.protocol: Use existing public protocol revision selected by Root
pins.runtime: Exact declared runtimes and immutable image digest references required; no latest tags/downloads
pins.source: Root supplies authoritative source_revision, selected dirty_snapshot_digest and sibling path dependency provenance; do not inspect/reset/stash Git

digest_rules.manifest: Canonical versioned serialized manifest with externally supplied expected SHA256 on verification; self-consistency alone is not authenticity
digest_rules.component: Reuse streamed existing bundle inventory hashes; canonical sorted relative file/type/size/mode/content digest rows, with a versioned deterministic encoding. Compare or populate every declared component digest from actual copied inventory, never echo caller values as observed
digest_rules.configuration: Digest only exact Root-selected redacted public configuration; credential/token/cookie/keychain contents never copied into a release

filesystem.inventory: Explicit caller-selected roots only, exact exclusions and bounds from recovery-bundle-v1; no PC-wide discovery
filesystem.source: No-follow fd anchors; fail if source changes during capture; source owners selected/stopped, not discovered/killed
filesystem.destination: New private owned destination only, immutable after commit; refuse overwrite and reject symlink/hardlink/traversal/tamper
filesystem.state: Release packaging does not silently snapshot live DBs; actual recovery already uses stopped consistent snapshots separately
filesystem.secrets: Credential exclusions remain exact source-owner declarations; never serialize private bytes into manifest or diagnostics

verification.root: Actual create→verify→tamper rejection on a selected owned temporary package; source/caller identity comparison and archive/bundle tests after handback
required: externally pinned manifest rejects tampered manifest
destination collision and symlink traversal rejected
